checks.result: Used the actual development session and real ledger progress update. A complete L1 pack at revision 183 (4997 tokens) supplied the saved context hash. The checkpoint captured one session event, two source observations and the real AWR-P5-001 entity revision 4 -> 5; two caller-reported code references stayed separate. Start/completion receipts, saved delta and latest checkpoint agree. The save committed at revision 185, session ended at 186, unfinished attempts were zero, source bytes were unchanged by checkpoint saving and doctor passed. Final bounded reader output matched the immutable completion receipt.

limitations: Feature-local checks and one real project self-use observation, not E4 acceptance, system benchmarking or release. Context hash and digest remain caller supplied and explicitly labeled; saving validates hash syntax rather than independently certifying context completeness. Source changes are project observations, not authorship claims. Incomplete attempts remain visible for later reconciliation. Legacy store checkpoints remain readable without fabricated deltas. Refreshed resume and broader recovery work remain scheduled.
